descriptions.zh: 一种非凡的类爬行物种在§Y[from.GetName]§!的剧毒大气中欣欣向荣，其秘诀就是一种可以将极端毒素破坏成有用养分的独特内器官。对这种有机体的进一步研究值得一试。
descriptions.en: A remarkable species of reptiloid thrives in the toxic atmosphere of §Y[from.GetName]§!, aided by a unique internal organ which breaks extreme toxins down into useful nutrients. Further study of this organism would be a worthy endeavor.

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!的气态外层由一种生活在其核心上的单细胞生物独特的生化过程所维持。将这些生物消灭可以让气体消散，使其下的岩质行星得以宜居。
descriptions.en: §Y[from.GetName]'s§! gassy outer layers are maintained by the unique biochemistry of unicellular organisms which inhabit its core. Exterminating them would dissipate these gasses, leaving us with a colonizable rocky planet.

descriptions.zh:
将物体送入§Y[from.GetName]§!的气态金属大气中可以形成天然镀层。

这一独特的过程非常高效，通过进一步研究可以进行复现并用于改进[Root.Owner.GetName]所有舰船船体的耐用度。
descriptions.en:
Sending objects into the gaseous metal atmosphere of §Y[from.GetName]§! results in a form of natural electroplating.

This unique process is remarkably effective and with further study could be replicated to improve ship hull durability across the [Root.Owner.GetName].

descriptions.zh: 研究§Y[from.GetName]§!上的超密度钻石后，我们确信其独特性质可以用于发展我们的激光科技。
descriptions.en: By studying the ultra-dense diamond storms on §Y[from.GetName]§!, we are confident that their unique properties can be used to advance our laser technologies.

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.GetName]§!上的一座受阻的超级火山之下储存着超大量富矿熔岩。进行受控喷发之后我们就可以收获这些被阻碍的资源了。
descriptions.en: A blocked supervolcano on §Y[from.GetName]§! is holding vast reserves of mineral-rich magma below the surface. Conducting a controlled eruption would allow us to harvest these trapped resources.

descriptions.zh: 通过对§H[from.GetName]§!上火龙卷的形成条件更密切的研究，就可以在受控环境中得以复现这种现象好的一面。
descriptions.en: By studying the conditions behind the flaming tornadoes of §H[from.GetName]§! more closely, the benefits of this phenomena could be recreated in a controlled environment.

descriptions.zh:
§Y[from.GetName]§!上的大型动物能抵御熔融星球上的极端环境，深深潜入行星上无数熔岩池之中。

研究这些生物的甲壳可能帮助我们理解如何抵御极端热量。
descriptions.en:
The megafauna on §Y[from.GetName]§! are able to withstand the harsh environments of their molten world, and submerge themselves deep below the surface of the planet's numerous magma pools.

Studying these creatures' carapaces may give us a new understanding of how to deal with extreme heat.

descriptions.zh: 通过重利用§Y[from.GetName]§!上受损的行星推进器阵列，我们将这颗气态巨行星的氢气焚烧殆尽，暴露出了底下可开采的固态核心。
descriptions.en: By repurposing the damaged planet thruster array on §Y[from.GetName]§!, we can burn away the gas giant's hydrogen leaving behind a solid and exploitable core.

descriptions.zh: 我们的[Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural]们通过研究§Y[from.GetName]§!上缇扬奇兽群的化石遗骸，旨在完全理解炼狱级核辐射对生物质的影响，并有可能发现全新的高级合金生产方式。
descriptions.en: By examining the petrified remains of the fossilized Tiyanki pod on §Y[from.GetName]§!, our [Root.Owner.GetScientistPlural] aim to fully understand the effects of chthonian-level radiation on biological matter, potentially opening up new means of advanced alloy production.

descriptions.zh: 研究§Y[from.GetName]§!精准的轨道共振效应将会提升我们对舰船机动中行星引力弹弓效应的理解。
descriptions.en: Studying the perfect orbital resonance effect on §Y[from.GetName]§! will improve our understanding of planetary slingshot maneuvers on ships.

descriptions.zh: 通过催化一些从[from.Planet.GetName]取回的毒性繁育黏液，我们或许可以从中孵出生物体。
descriptions.en: By catalyzing some of the toxic gestational slime recovered from [from.Planet.GetName] we may be able to spawn a living organism from it.

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上找回的残损方舟上收集有一些复杂的数学证明，被称为《历代志》。我们对其展开研究，只旨在进一步地了解邓德里人所寻找的天堂星球§Y新布拉图雅§!。
descriptions.en: By studying the "Chronicles", a collection of complex mathematical proofs recovered from the wrecked arkship on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!, we aim to learn more about the paradise planet sought by the Dendritians, §YNew Bratulla§!.

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上找回的残损方舟上收集有一些复杂的数学证明，被称为《历代志》。我们对其展开研究，只旨在进一步地了解邓德里人所寻找的天堂星球§Y新布拉图雅§!。
descriptions.en: By studying the "Chronicles", a collection of complex mathematical proofs recovered from the wrecked arkship on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!, we aim to learn more about the paradise planet sought by the Dendritians, §YNew Bratulla§!.

titles.zh: 修复退化的超空间航道

descriptions.zh: 如果我们能找到修复§Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!中退化的超空间航道的方法，我们就能确认§Y新布拉图雅§!，这颗邓德里人所寻找的天堂星球是否存在。
descriptions.en: If we can find a way to restore the degraded hyperlane in §Y[from.solar_system.GetName]§!, we will be able to confirm the existence of §YNew Bratulla§!, the paradise planet sought by the Dendritians.

descriptions.zh: 追踪着与§Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上的装置完全一致的通讯频率找到的这一位置，而这里又发现了一台受损的装置。进行研究可以取得对他们的破坏性环境改造能力更深入的洞见。
descriptions.en: An identical communications frequency to the one emitted by the construct found on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! has been traced to this site, where another damaged device has been located. Studying it will yield further insight into their destructive terraforming capabilities.

descriptions.zh: §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§!上找到的设施发出的通讯频率还指向这个地点，我们在这里又找到了一台受损的设备。进行研究可以取得对他们的破坏性环境改造能力更深入的洞见。
descriptions.en: The communications frequency emitted by the construct found on §Y[from.Planet.GetName]§! has also been traced to this site, where another damaged device has been located. Studying it will yield further insight into their destructive terraforming capabilities.

descriptions.zh: 我们在§Y[planet.GetName]§!找到了第四个还未引爆的环境改造装置。将其取回之后就能让我们完全理解这一科技了。
descriptions.en: We have located a fourth, as yet undetonated terraforming device on §Y[planet.GetName]§!. Recovering it will fill the gaps in our understanding of this technology.

descriptions.zh: 通过分析§Y[planet.GetName]§!上找到的这台装置的控制结构，我们就能复制这项科技为自己所用。
descriptions.en: By analyzing the control architecture of the device found on §Y[planet.GetName]§!, we will be able to replicate this technology for our own use.

descriptions.zh: 通过分析§Y[planet.GetName]§!上找到的这台装置的控制结构，我们就能复制这项科技为自己所用。
descriptions.en: By analyzing the control architecture of the device found on §Y[planet.GetName]§!, we will be able to replicate this technology for our own use.
